news_headlines.title: Silver Lake affiliates sell large DELL Class C blocks (DELL)
news_headlines.summary: Affiliates of Silver Lake have filed a Form 144 indicating proposed and recent sales of Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) Class C Common Stock. The filing details an intent to sell a 7,000-share lot acquired in 2023 and reports an extensive series of large block sales by various Silver Lake funds between March 2 and April 15, 2026, with significant gross proceeds for each transaction. This activity represents routine monetization of positions by private-equity vehicles, with the impact on DELL's share price depending on market absorption.

news_headlines.title: Silver Lake lists large Dell (NYSE: DELL) Class C share sales in Form 144
news_headlines.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL) has reported proposed sales of Class C Common Stock by affiliated Silver Lake entities as detailed in a Form 144 filing. The filing indicates numerous sale transactions in March and April 2026, including large blocks of shares, and notes that some Class C shares were acquired through conversion from Class B Common Stock on April 16, 2026. This notice is a procedural step enabling sales under Rule 144's safe-harbor framework.

news_headlines.title: Dell (DELL) Form 144: Silver Lake sales and 155,479-share conversion notice
news_headlines.summary: Dell Technologies has filed Form 144 notices for a proposed sale of 155,479 shares of Class C Common Stock, which were acquired by converting Class B Common Stock. The filing also documents numerous past sales by Silver Lake entities, including a significant block of 189,679 shares sold by Silver Lake Partners IV on April 15, 2026. As of April 16, 2026, Dell had 318,358,135 shares outstanding.

news_headlines.title: Silver Lake disposals continue; DELL (NYSE: DELL) resale activity details
news_headlines.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE: DELL) filed a Form 144 resale notice for 2,996 shares of Class C Common Stock, acquired through conversion of Class B Common Stock on April 16, 2026. This filing also details extensive secondary sales by various Silver Lake entities throughout March and April 2026, including large tranches of shares sold on multiple dates. The document lists transaction quantities and gross proceeds for each trade by the selling stockholders, who are primarily Silver Lake affiliates.

news_headlines.title: DELL (NYSE: DELL) Form 144 lists 135,097 Class C shares for resale; Silver Lake sales noted
news_headlines.summary: Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) has filed a Form 144 notice for the proposed resale of 135,097 Class C Common Stock shares, acquired from the conversion of Class B Common Stock on April 16, 2026. The filing also details numerous prior sales by various Silver Lake entities throughout March and April 2026, including specific share counts and aggregate dollar amounts. This notice signifies a planned resale of existing shares by current holders and does not imply new share issuance or dilution by Dell itself.

news_headlines.title: Western Union telegraphs move from VMware to Nutanix
news_headlines.summary: Western Union is migrating its cloud services from VMware to Nutanix, driven by the need for greater flexibility and Broadcom's service and pricing changes for VMware. Brandon Shaw, VP and head of technology services at Western Union, stated that while the decision was not taken lightly, it was necessary to address an aging virtualization platform and align with the company's long-term strategy. This move reflects a broader trend of dissatisfaction among former VMware customers following Broadcom's acquisition and subsequent changes.

news_headlines.title: Bit Origin Pursues AI Computing and Data Center Expansion
news_headlines.summary: Bit Origin Ltd has secured strategic financing to explore expanding into AI-driven computing, storage infrastructure, and cooling services, leveraging its Bitcoin mining experience. The company plans to evaluate leasing and managing GPU-based computing resources and systems, although execution is contingent on further financing, commercial agreements, and qualified personnel. This move is presented as an exploratory phase, aiming for a capital-efficient approach by repositioning existing resources.

news_headlines.title: Monroe Capital’s 64% Dividend Cut Signals Deeper Portfolio Trouble Ahead
news_headlines.summary: Monroe Capital Corp (MRCC) has cut its quarterly dividend by 64% after struggling to cover payouts with net investment income throughout 2025, leading to a significant drop in NAV per share. The company, a BDC, used accumulated spillover income to fund dividends, but its portfolio deteriorated with rising non-accrual investments. Now, with a merger with Horizon Technology Finance Corporation (HRZN) imminent, MRCC shareholders will become HRZN stockholders, also receiving special distributions.

news_headlines.title: Super Micro Computer Stock at Support Zone – Bargain or Trap?
news_headlines.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) stock is currently trading in a significant support zone, from which it has historically bounced back with substantial returns. Despite near-term concerns like revenue dips and margin pressure, the company benefits from strong AI server market growth and key partnerships with NVIDIA, indicating a likely rebound. However, historical performance shows that SMCI is also susceptible to significant drops during broad market downturns, highlighting the importance of a diversified portfolio approach.
